question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"whereas."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Whereas"** is used to contrast two different ideas or situations.
 
• It is commonly used to introduce a second clause that contradicts or contrasts with the first clause.
 
 
• **Example:** *John loves to eat pizza, **whereas**__ his sister prefers sushi.*
 
 
 
• Here, we are talking about two different industries, IT and healthcare.&
